decision: Publish a GHCR latest compatibility tag after every fully verified Keyku release while keeping official Compose files pinned to immutable semantic-version tags.
rationale: Existing ZimaOS installations explicitly configured to track latest otherwise remain on the historical 0.2.1 image and miss security, compatibility, and icon updates.
scope: The release workflow promotes the exact already-built, scanned, and provenance-attested multi-architecture digest after all release gates pass. It never rebuilds during promotion and official installation files do not consume latest.
risk_controls: Promotion runs only after full verification, both architecture vulnerability scans, and provenance attestation succeed.
The immutable semantic-version tag and digest remain the authoritative release and rollback references.
A digest equality check fails the release if latest does not resolve to the promoted release index.
removal_plan: Remove the compatibility tag after all managed ZimaOS installations use an immutable semantic-version tag or digest.
